rules: ALL rules start with: some attestation in input.attestations
NEVER reuse 'result' variable - reserved for deny output
Use descriptive variable names for loops (task_result, r, param, etc.)

single_key_001.natural_language: Verify the build task has status 'Succeeded'.
single_key_001.rego_code:
deny contains result if {
    some attestation in input.attestations
    some task in attestation.statement.predicate.buildConfig.tasks
    task.name == "build"
    task.status != "Succeeded"
    result := sprintf("Build task status is %s, expected Succeeded", [task.status])
}
